_comment: SYNTHETIC clinic website. No real clinic, no real doctors, no real patients.
This is the grounding corpus: it is ingested into clinic_documents, chunked into
document_chunks with character offsets preserved, and every factual answer the
assistant gives about the clinic must cite a span in here. If a question cannot be
answered from this corpus the assistant says so rather than inventing a fact.
Multi-specialty on purpose. The demo needs cardiac (risk gate) and fertility
(stigma, Family Communication Kit) in the same clinic, which is also just what
Malaysian private healthcare actually looks like.
Written to include the things people actually ask before booking and the things
report C&D found they forget to ask and later regret - fasting rules, whether the
doctor explains results in person, insurance, whether a chaperone can be requested.

documents.title: Our Services
documents.raw_text:
Harmoni Medical Centre — Our Services

Harmoni Medical Centre is a private multi-specialty outpatient clinic in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. We see adults and children, and we hold clinics in five areas.

GENERAL AND FAMILY MEDICINE
Walk-in and appointment consultations for everyday illness, minor injuries, medical certificates, vaccinations and referrals. No appointment is needed for general medicine, though booked patients are seen first.

CARDIAC AND HEALTH SCREENING
Structured screening packages covering blood pressure, lipid profile, fasting blood glucose, ECG and, where indicated, treadmill stress testing and echocardiography. Screening is aimed at people with a family history of heart disease, people over 40, and anyone whose doctor has advised cardiovascular assessment. Screening is not a substitute for emergency care: chest pain, breathlessness or collapse should go to a hospital emergency department, not to a screening appointment.

WOMEN'S HEALTH AND GYNAECOLOGY
Cervical screening (pap smear and HPV testing), contraception counselling, menstrual and menopause concerns, pelvic ultrasound, and management of fibroids and ovarian cysts. A female chaperone is available for any examination on request, and you do not need to give a reason for asking.

FERTILITY SERVICES
Initial fertility assessment for individuals and couples, including hormone profiling, semen analysis, ovulation tracking and tubal patency assessment. We provide assessment, counselling and ovulation induction on site. In-vitro fertilisation (IVF) is not performed at Harmoni; where IVF is appropriate we refer to a partner centre and continue to support you through the process.

PAEDIATRICS
Well-baby checks, childhood immunisation following the Malaysian national schedule, growth and development review, and acute illness in children. Children with fever are seen in a separate waiting area from well-baby appointments.

WHAT WE DO NOT PROVIDE
We are not an emergency department. We do not have an inpatient ward, we do not perform surgery, and we are not open overnight. If you need urgent care outside our hours, the nearest 24-hour emergency departments are at the major hospitals in Petaling Jaya and Subang Jaya.

documents.title: Hours, Location and Contact
documents.raw_text:
Visiting Harmoni Medical Centre

OPENING HOURS
Monday to Thursday: 8:30am to 6:00pm
Friday: 8:30am to 12:15pm, then 2:30pm to 6:00pm (closed for Friday prayers)
Saturday: 9:00am to 1:00pm
Sunday and public holidays: closed

Last registration is 30 minutes before closing. On Saturdays the clinic is busiest between 9:00am and 11:00am.

WE ARE NOT OPEN OVERNIGHT
If you have a medical emergency at any time, call 999 or go directly to a hospital emergency department. Do not wait for us to open.

LOCATION
Harmoni Medical Centre, Ground Floor, Menara Harmoni, Jalan Semangat, Seksyen 13, 46200 Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

Parking is available in the basement, with the first hour free for patients when you validate at reception. The clinic is a seven-minute walk from the nearest LRT station. The entrance is step-free and there is a lift to all floors.

CONTACT
Telephone: 03-7955 0100 during opening hours.
Appointments can be made by phone, through the website, or through this assistant.

WAITING TIMES
Booked appointments are usually seen within 20 minutes of the appointment time. Walk-in general medicine patients are seen in order of arrival and typically wait 45 to 90 minutes, longer on Saturday mornings and on the first weekday after a public holiday.

LANGUAGES
Our doctors and nurses speak English, Bahasa Malaysia and Mandarin. Tamil-speaking staff are available on Tuesdays and Thursdays. If you would prefer to be seen by someone who speaks a particular language, tell reception when you book and we will try to arrange it.

documents.title: Fees and Payment
documents.raw_text:
Fees and Payment at Harmoni Medical Centre

All prices are in Malaysian Ringgit and include SST where applicable. Prices were last reviewed in January 2026.

CONSULTATIONS
General medicine consultation: RM 60 to RM 90 depending on length and complexity.
Specialist consultation (cardiology, gynaecology, fertility, paediatrics): RM 150 to RM 220 for a first appointment, RM 100 to RM 140 for a follow-up.
Medication, dressings, injections and procedures are charged separately.

SCREENING PACKAGES
Basic health screening: RM 380. Includes consultation, blood pressure, full blood count, lipid profile, fasting glucose, renal and liver function, urinalysis.
Cardiac screening: RM 750. Adds resting ECG, chest X-ray and a cardiologist review.
Comprehensive cardiac screening: RM 1,450. Adds treadmill stress test and echocardiography.

WOMEN'S HEALTH
Pap smear with consultation: RM 190.
Pap smear with HPV co-testing: RM 340.
Pelvic ultrasound: RM 250.

FERTILITY
Initial fertility consultation for an individual or couple: RM 220.
Female hormone profile: RM 480.
Semen analysis: RM 180.
Ovulation tracking cycle (three to four scans): RM 600.
We do not perform IVF at Harmoni. Where IVF is recommended we will explain why, refer you to a partner centre and tell you what that centre charges before you commit to anything.

WHAT MIGHT COST MORE THAN THE HEADLINE PRICE
If a screening finds something that needs further investigation, those additional tests are billed separately and are not included in the package price. We will always tell you the cost before proceeding, and you can decline or take time to decide.

INSURANCE
We are on the panel of several major insurers and can bill them directly for eligible consultations. Whether preventive screening is covered depends on your specific policy — many policies cover investigation of symptoms but not routine screening. Bring your card and we will verify coverage before your appointment where possible.

PAYMENT METHODS
Cash, credit and debit cards, DuitNow QR and major e-wallets. Instalment plans are available for screening packages and fertility investigation over RM 1,000; ask at reception.

documents.title: Preparing for Your Appointment
documents.raw_text:
Preparing for Your Appointment

FASTING
Fasting blood tests, including fasting glucose and lipid profile, require 8 to 10 hours without food. You may and should drink plain water. Do not fast longer than 12 hours. If you take regular medication, take it as normal with water unless your doctor has specifically told you otherwise, and tell us what you have taken.

If you are diabetic and take insulin or medication that lowers blood sugar, speak to us before fasting. Do not skip a meal and a dose without advice.

WHAT TO BRING
Your identity card or passport, your insurance card if you have one, a list of every medication and supplement you take including traditional and herbal preparations, and any previous test results or discharge summaries you have. Photographs of medication boxes on your phone are perfectly acceptable.

CERVICAL SCREENING
Avoid scheduling a pap smear during your period. Avoid vaginal medication, lubricants or intercourse for 48 hours beforehand. Some light spotting after the test is common and usually settles within a day. A female chaperone is available on request and you do not need to explain why you want one.

TREADMILL STRESS TEST
Wear comfortable clothing and walking shoes. Avoid caffeine for 12 hours beforehand. Do not stop any heart medication unless your doctor has told you to. If you have knee, hip or back problems that make walking difficult, tell us when booking — there are alternative tests and we can arrange one instead.

BRINGING CHILDREN
For a well-baby visit, bring the child's health record book. For a sick child, bring a note of the temperature readings you have taken at home and the times you took them, and roughly how much the child has had to drink.

GETTING YOUR RESULTS
Most blood results are ready within two working days, and imaging within three. Results are explained to you by a doctor, either at a follow-up appointment or by phone if the results are straightforward and you would prefer that. We do not hand over a printed report without explaining it. If a result needs urgent attention we will contact you directly rather than waiting for your next appointment.

documents.title: Questions People Ask Us
documents.raw_text:
Questions People Ask Us

DO I NEED AN APPOINTMENT?
Not for general medicine — you can walk in. Specialist clinics, screening packages and fertility consultations do need to be booked.

CAN I ASK FOR A FEMALE DOCTOR?
Yes. We have female doctors in general medicine, women's health and paediatrics. Tell reception when you book. A female chaperone is available for any examination regardless of the doctor's gender, and you never need to give a reason.

WILL MY EMPLOYER OR MY FAMILY FIND OUT WHAT I CAME FOR?
No. Your medical record is confidential. We do not tell your employer why you attended, and a medical certificate states dates only, not a diagnosis. We do not discuss your care with family members unless you have told us we may. If you are attending for something you would rather keep private, you can say so and we will note it.

HOW LONG WILL A SCREENING APPOINTMENT TAKE?
Basic screening takes about 90 minutes from registration. Cardiac screening with a stress test takes about three hours. Bring something to read.

WHAT IF THE SCREENING FINDS SOMETHING?
A doctor explains the result to you in person and walks you through the options. Additional tests are charged separately and we will tell you the cost before anything is done. Finding something early is the point of screening; it does not by itself mean the news is bad.

CAN I BRING SOMEONE WITH ME?
Yes. You are welcome to bring a partner, family member or friend into the consultation. You are equally welcome to ask them to wait outside for part of it, and we will help you do that without it becoming awkward.

DO YOU TREAT PEOPLE WHO HAVE BEEN USING TRADITIONAL OR HERBAL MEDICINE?
Yes, and please tell us what you have been taking. We ask because some preparations interact with prescription medicines, not to judge you for taking them.

I AM NOT SURE MY PROBLEM IS SERIOUS ENOUGH TO COME IN.
That is a very common worry and it is not a waste of anyone's time to ask. If you are unsure, a general medicine consultation is the right place to start, and if it turns out to be nothing we will tell you that plainly.

WHAT IF I NEED HELP WHEN YOU ARE CLOSED?
Call 999 or go to a hospital emergency department. Do not wait for us to open. Chest pain, difficulty breathing, heavy bleeding, sudden weakness on one side of the body, or thoughts of harming yourself all need attention straight away, not an appointment.
